name: Touch of Weakness
summary: A priestess welcomes you back and offers a lesson in weakness. Her words make clear that she expects you to return ready to learn.

sections.title: A Lesson Offered
sections.body: A priestess greets you when you return and says she is glad to see you. She offers to teach you a lesson she expects you to remember. The lesson itself remains ahead, and she asks if you are ready.

faq.q: Who is asking me to learn?
faq.answer: A priestess welcomes you back and offers to teach you a lesson.

faq.q: What does the priestess want to teach me?
faq.answer: She offers a lesson she says you would do well to remember.
The priestess is glad you have returned and asks whether you are ready for a lesson.

angles.text: As a priest, you are addressed as a young priestess and offered a lesson.

attribution: In-game quest text: Touch of Weakness
